messages:
oliver: quick follow-up from the PM - we have 4 open action items. need single R/A, jira links, short AC, and rollback commands so oncall can act fast.
sana: I can own the cache-bump item (PMT-8123). plan: reproduce, add metric, PR with test. R: sana, A: oliver, C: runtime. ETA: Thu EOD.
yuri: I'll take the autoscaler drift (PMT-8137). will add canary plan + rollback one-liner. R: yuri, A: cam. ETA: Mon canary.
cam: adding acceptance criteria template to both tickets: `repro steps; metrics added; PR + tests; canary 24h passing` — please paste this into the AC field.
sana: added AC to PMT-8123 and linked historical incident from Feb. labeled `recurring-pattern`.
ops-bot: PMT-8123 assigned to sana; reminder set for 2026-04-03T17:00:00Z.
yuri: created PMT-8137 and EPIC-11011 "recurring-infra-signatures". linking both tickets. will surface a small Grafana panel.
oliver: process ask: let's update RACI with a "postmortem handoff" lane: single R, single A, interim owner if >72h OOO, auto-escalate after 7d inactivity. who can edit the doc?
cam: I can update the RACI doc and add examples + PR. will include audit-close requirement (who closed + timestamp).
sana: small note 14  when assigning, put a 2-line ETA and AC in the ticket comment so it's obvious in lists. reduced friction last time.
yuri: will add canary steps to PMT-8137: ```
1) deploy to 10% pool
2) monitor error rate in 1m windows
3) revert if error >0.5% or latency >2x
```
oliver: timeline: PMT-8123 -> Thu EOD, PMT-8137 -> canary Mon, RACI PR -> cam by Wed. 15m sync Mon 10:45 UTC to confirm canary. please update Jira before the sync.
cam: PR opened for RACI doc, link: internal/gh/raci-postmortem-handback (WIP).
ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled for 2026-04-06T10:45:00Z.
oliver: thanks everyone. marking thread as follow-up in progress. :thumbsup:
